entities.summary: An uninhabited archaeological island where sanctuaries, houses, commercial quarters, mosaics and terraces survive within the original Aegean landscape.
entities.description: Delos is experienced as a ferry-bound archaeological world: visitors disembark into a large ancient sacred and commercial city with no modern town layered over it. The visit rewards several hours, a guide or prior context, and preparation for sun, wind and ferry timing.
entities.whyWorthwhile: Few archaeological sites preserve such strong separation from the modern world; the island journey and exposed ancient city create exceptional historical atmosphere.
